subject: Kickoff alignment
body: Good kickoff session, appreciated how clearly you laid out the compliance mapping approach. Feels like we're starting from a strong foundation.

subject: Early policy draft feedback
body: First look at the draft policy framework, directionally this is right. A few of my analysts will send line-level comments but nothing structural.

subject: Policy framework doc - excellent work
body: This is exactly what we needed. Clear, well-organized, and it maps cleanly to our compliance requirements. My legal team had almost no comments, which never happens.

subject: Data classification workshop
body: Thanks for running the classification workshop yesterday, my team walked away with a much clearer sense of how the tiers should apply to our datasets.

subject: Thank you for the fast turnaround
body: I know I sent that data lineage question late on a Friday and didn't expect an answer until Monday. Getting a thorough response Saturday morning was above and beyond. Really appreciate the responsiveness.

subject: Access control review
body: Reviewed the access control recommendations, no pushback from our side. Straightforward and well justified.

subject: Quick compliance mapping question
body: One of our vendors asked how their certification maps to our new framework. Could your team help translate that for us this week? Not urgent.

subject: Steering committee feedback
body: Wanted to pass along that our CDO specifically called out this workstream as the model for how the other governance tracks should run. Well deserved, thank you.

subject: Audit prep update
body: Appreciate you getting ahead of the external audit prep before we even asked. That kind of foresight is exactly why this workstream runs so smoothly.

subject: Looking ahead to Q4 scope
body: Given how well this has gone, I'd like to start scoping additional Q4 governance work with your team. Can we find time in the next two weeks?
